author: jaeder@wehavecookies.social
text: Just wrapped Brand New Day. It's the first time in two decades that I've felt fulfilled from a Spider-Man movie. And I think it's partially due to the story actually being up to par, and because we've actually laid the groundwork for this character across the years. If this is the swan song for this version of the character that's ok, but I feel like there's so much left to explore that I'd personally really love to see. Peter Parker is a character that I've loved ever since I was maybe 6 or 7 years old. And there are so many amazing stories already told, and there's so much depth and various venues to explore through it. Thank you to the whole production crew, thank you so much. I doubt many of them hang out on Mastodon, but still. #spidermanbrandnewday #spiderman #marvelstudios

author: jaeder@wehavecookies.social
text: I'm about halfway through Spider-Man: Brand New Day and right now I can't help but really wish for a prolonged character arc. I REALLY don't want them to switch over to another Spider-Man. Again. Let this character grow. Please. PLEEEEASE. It was one of the things that made the comic book I read as a kid so god damn good and... reassuring somehow. I got to see Spider-Man struggle, in different forms (though I honestly didn't really get the alternate Spider-Man universes back then, I kept getting confused about how to fit it all into a timeline for a long time) and in ups and downs. The Tom Holland Spider-Man, especially with Brand New Day, feels like it has SO much more potential. If we get a proper TV series I'd be all over. #spidermanbrandnewday #spiderman #marvelstudios

text: I've been seeing comments online about people botching and moaning because they didn't know the extra scenes were tied to ticket tiers. Like if you got a normal/imax ticket, you only got to see a couple of the new scenes; whereas if you bought the specific "Infinity Vision" ticket, you get to see all of them (all 4-ish minutes that's right at the very end of the movie making the rest of the rerelease literally pointless). I'm glad I decided early on not to waste my time or money with this one. Like it's cool I guess if you're wanting to see it in theaters again, but it by no means is worth the extra ticket upcharge just to see a couple extra mid-credits scenes that honestly are out of place in Endgame. I'm almost positive that one of the extra scenes was supposed to be the credits scene for Brand New Day, but it was shoved into Endgame because Marvel is still scrambling because of the John Majors backlash and don't know how to properly build hype for their movies anymore.

text: #2026已看電影 13 #蜘蛛人_重生日 這部我們因為各自的工作，沒有趕上「第一時間」，看完之後很五味雜陳，這當然是因為MCU對我們這個世代，有屬於它獨有的意義。 以下我只想先條列： 1.說穿整個故事的那句話，刻在梅嬸的墓碑上，「幫助一個人，就是幫助所有人」。 2.拷問的那個課題，在一張貼紙上”No credit”也可以看成「沒有信用」；”Don’t ask”則是個警醒。 3.如果電影是移動房子，「制裁者」這個角色、這個演員，就是為了蓋起票房被打的生樁。漫威要拿來搞笑，卻幾乎都是隔靴搔癢，真正好笑的只有「醫院頭套」那場戲，但也完全把這個角色「毀乾淨了」。 4.千黛亞的演技實力展現的兩場場戲：「附身」、「拿信質問」。 「附身」那場戲，一是很明顯能感受到千黛亞模仿了Sadie Sink的口音、語氣與說話方式，而且對戲的人可是現實中的丈夫（還是跟現實中他們甜到螢幕會長螞蟻截然相反的路線），真的厲害。 「拿信質問」一整段，確實把心碎的張力催出來了，能在「劇本殺」的戰場上有一條自己的活路，真的好看。 #鳴鏑_按下暫停鍵 #SpiderManBrandNewDay

author: fortyseven@defcon.social
text: #BrandNewDay was excellent. I mean, the last one was a lot of fun, and I love it... but this was like... Spider-Man's 'Thunderbolts'. :P A new favorite, I think? But why I loved it, may turn others off: it's a long film and it uses that time to let the characters and moments breathe. There's a lot of emotional stuff to churn through and it gives Peter, especially, the chance to really marinate in it, in a way that I appreciate. Regarding the 'mystery character' Sadie Sink is playing, it literally is just a repeat of the needless drama around Star Trek Into Darkness: everyone already figured out who it was, there was zero reason to hide it. It's stupid, and unnecessarily puts a burden on the actress, IMHO. Covering it up added nothing to the mystery. Perhaps even less than 'Khan' in STID. 4.5/5 #SpiderMan

text: Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026) – Review Look you guys, I’m going to come clean. As much as I adored the spider-themed nostalgia explosion that was Spider-Man: No Way Home, that ending hurt me pretty bad. Second only to the mass dusting of the majority of the cast of Avengers: Infinity War, the forgotten-ing of Peter Parker in order to save the multiverse was possibly too much tragedy to bear for even this weathered spider-veteran. Yes, the saying goes that for Spider-Man to be at his best, Peter Parker has to suffer, but surely this was crueler than a dozen slain Gwen Staceys. Even since the December of 2021, I’ve been waiting with bated breath to see what horrible injustices the MCU has in store for comic’s most beloved punching bag in the hope that the wall crawler can catch some semblance of a break. text: #datocurioso ¿Sabías que el nuevo traje de Peter Parker en esta entrega oculta un cambio biológico radical? En la película Spider-Man: Brand New Day, el héroe regresa a sus orígenes más clásicos combatiendo el crimen callejero en solitario, pero los avances oficiales confirman que su cuerpo experimenta una mutación descontrolada que cambia las reglas del juego. Por primera vez en la saga interpretada por Tom Holland, el personaje deja atrás los avanzados dispositivos mecánicos creados por él mismo o por Industrias Stark para generar telarañas orgánicas directamente desde sus propias muñecas. Este cambio físico recrea una de las características más famosas de la vieja trilogía original de inicios de la centuria y obliga al arácnido a buscar la ayuda experta de Bruce Banner para intentar controlar la sorprendente evolución de sus poderes. author: jordanlund
text: Brand New Day is going to build on the previous Spider-Man films, SPECIFICALLY the film immediately previous, Spider-Man: No Way Home. Which is an EXCELLENT Spider-Man film. But, in order to fully appreciate that one, you have to be aware of the previous attempts at Spider-Man, the original trilogy with Tobey Maguire, and the reboot with Andrew Garfield. Even No Way Home deals with the cliffhanger at the end of Spider-Man Far From Home. My advice, if you have the time, at least catch up with No Way Home. That's going to explain a lot of the stuff that you should know going in to the new one. Heck, even people who watched all three of the previous films might want to do a re-watch. 😉

Selon plusieurs sources, il s’agirait d’un accident de cascade qui aurait entraîné une commotion légère. Si la production a immédiatement suspendu le tournage, les proches de l’acteur se veulent rassurants : il devrait revenir très prochainement sur le plateau.
